title: Build Your Own Boxing Empire! | Boxing Tycoon
author: B0nkybonk_
selftext:
Hi everyone! We'd like to introduce our game, Boxing Tycoon, where you get to run your own boxing promotion!

Scout rising talent, sign fighters, and negotiate contracts. Manage your gyms, build exciting fight cards, and watch your fighters battle it out in full 3D. Every decision shapes your promotion's future!

Think you have what it takes? Wishlist Boxing Tycoon now on Steam!

AI Generated Content Disclosure

We used generative AI tools during development. All of this content was created before release, reviewed and edited by our team, and ships with the game:

\- Character portraits (fighters, promoters, agents, journalists and staff) were created with AI image tools.  
\- The 3D fighter models started from AI-generated base models, which we rigged, animated and refined for the game.  
\- Some cinematic scenes (negotiations, press conferences, venues) use AI-generated video.  
\- The ring announcer and commentary voices were generated with AI text-to-speech.  
\- The ring walk songs and in-game music were created with AI music tools.  
\- Some store artwork, including the key art, was created with AI tools.
